traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +4 racial bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

traits.name: Greed
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks made to determine the price of non-magical goods that contain precious metals or gemstones.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +2 bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework, such as traps and hidden doors located in stone walls or floors. They receive a check to notice such features whenever they pass within 10 feet of them, whether or not they are actively looking.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Dwarves can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Dwarves gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the orc and goblinoid subtypes because of their special training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Dwarves are proficient with battleaxes, heavy picks, and warhammers, and treat any weapon with the word “dwarven” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Elven Immunities
traits.text: Elves are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Elven Magic
traits.text: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft skill checks made to identify the properties of magic items.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Elves are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows), longswords, rapiers, and shortbows (including composite shortbows), and treat any weapon with the word “elven” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Gnomes gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC against monsters of the giant subtype.

traits.name: Illusion Resistance
traits.text: Gnomes gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against illusion spells and effects.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Gnomes receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Obsessive
traits.text: Gnomes receive a +2 racial bonus on a Craft or Profession skill of their choice.

traits.name: Gnome Magic
traits.text: Gnomes add +1 to the DC of any saving throws against illusion spells that they cast. Gnomes with Charisma scores of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—dancing lights, ghost sound, prestidigitation, and speak with animals. The caster level for these effects is equal to the gnome’s level. The DC for these spells is equal to 10 + the spell’s level + the gnome’s Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Gnomes receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and goblinoid subtypes because of their special training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Gnomes treat any weapon with the word “gnome” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Gnomes can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Elven Immunities
traits.text: Half-elves are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.

traits.name: Adaptability
traits.text: Half-elves receive Skill Focus as a bonus feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Half-elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Half-elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Elf Blood
traits.text: Half-elves count as both elves and humans for any effect related to race.

traits.name: Multitalented
traits.text: Half-elves choose two favored classes at first level and gain +1 hit point or +1 skill point whenever they take a level in either one of those classes.

traits.name: Intimidating
traits.text: Half-orcs receive a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks due to their fearsome nature.

traits.name: Orc Ferocity
traits.text: Once per day, when a half-orc is brought below 0 hit points but not killed, he can fight on for 1 more round as if disabled. At the end of his next turn, unless brought to above 0 hit points, he immediately falls unconscious and begins dying.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Half-orcs are proficient with greataxes and falchions and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Half-orcs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Orc Blood
traits.text: Half-orcs count as both humans and orcs for any effect related to race.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.text: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws against fear. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by halfling luck.

traits.name: Halfling Luck
traits.text: Halflings receive a +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.text: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Halflings are proficient with slings and treat any weapon with the word “halfling” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Halflings receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.text: Humans select one extra feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Humans gain an additional skill rank at first level and one additional rank whenever they gain a level.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.text: Aasimars have acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Aasimar have a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perception checks.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: Aasimars can use daylight once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to the aasimar’s class level).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Aasimar have darkvision 60 ft. (they can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.)

traits.name: Natural Hunter
traits.text: Catfolk receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

traits.name: Sprinter
traits.text: Catfolk gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Catfolk have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Undead Resistance
traits.text: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease and mind-affecting effects.

traits.name: Resist Level Drain (Ex)
traits.text: A dhampir takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels then he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a dhampir takes are removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities (Su)
traits.text: A dhampir can use detect undead three times per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability equals the dhampir’s class level.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Dhampir see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-light vision
traits.text: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, dhampir have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Dhampirs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

traits.name: Negative Energy Affinity
traits.text: Though a living creature, a dhampir reacts to positive and negative energy as if it were undead—positive energy harms it, while negative energy heals it.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Drow are proficient with the hand crossbow, rapier, and shortsword.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: Drow possess spell resistance (SR) equal to 6 plus their total number of class levels.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities (Su)
traits.text: Drow can cast dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire, once each per day, using their total character level as caster level.

traits.name: Poison Use
traits.text: Drow are skilled in the use of poisons and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.text: Drow have superior darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Light Blindness
traits.text: As deep underground dwellers naturally, drow suffer from light blindness. Abrupt exposure to any bright light blinds drow for 1 round. On subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

traits.name: Shadow Blending (Su)
traits.text: Attacks against a fetchling in dim light have a 50% miss chance instead of the normal 20% miss chance. This ability does not grant total concealment; it just increases the miss chance.

traits.name: Shadowy Resistance
traits.text: Fetchlings have cold resistance 5 and electricity resistance 5.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Fetchlings have a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (planes) and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)
traits.text: A fetchling can use disguise self once per day as a spell-like ability. He can assume the form of any humanoid creature. A fetchling’s caster level is equal to his total Hit Dice. When a fetchling reaches 9th level in any combination of classes, he gains shadow walk (self only) as a spell-like ability usable once per day as a spell-like ability. A fetchling’s caster level is equal to his total Hit Dice. When a fetchling reaches 13th level in any combination of classes, he gains plane shift (self only, to the Shadow Plane or the Material Plane only) usable once per day as a spell-like ability. A fetchling’s caster level is equal to his total Hit Dice.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Fetchlings can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, fetchlings have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Goblins gain a +4 racial bonus on Ride and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Fast Movement
traits.text: Goblins gain a +10 foot bonus to their base speed (this is already added to their Base Speed above.)

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Goblins see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: Hobgoblins receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Hobgoblins can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Ifrits have fire resistance 5.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: Ifrits can use burning hands 1/day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit’s level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

traits.name: Fire Affinity
traits.text: Ifrit sorcerers with the elemental (fire) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ifrit spellcasters with the Fire domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ifrits can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.text: Race Point Costs

traits.name: Armor
traits.text: Kobolds naturally scaly skin grants them a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Crafty
traits.text: Kobolds gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (trapmaking), Perception, and Profession (miner) checks. Craft (trapmaking) and Stealth are always class skills for a kobold.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Kobolds can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Kobolds lives in darkness have caused them to suffer from light sensitivity.

traits.name: Ferocity
traits.text: Orcs possess the ferocity ability which allows them to remain conscious and continue fighting even if their hit point totals fall below 0. Orcs are still staggered at 0 hit points or lower and lose 1 hit point each round as normal.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Orcs can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Orcs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

traits.name: Speed (Slow)
traits.text: Oreads have a base speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Oreads have acid resistance 5.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Oreads can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Earth Affinity
traits.text: Oread sorcerers with the elemental (earth) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Oread clerics with the Earth domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

traits.name: Speed (Slow)
traits.text: Ratfolk have a base speed of 20 ft.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

traits.name: Rodent Empathy
traits.text: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.

traits.name: Swarming
traits.text: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes’ detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Ratfolk can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Sylphs have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Sylphs have electricity resistance 5.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Sylphs can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Air Affinity
traits.text: Sylph sorcerers with the elemental (air) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Sylph spellcasters with the Air domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Tengus have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.text: Tengus gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Gifted Linguist
traits.text: Tengus gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn 2 languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than 1 language.

traits.name: Swordtrained
traits.text: Tengus are trained from birth in swordplay, and as a result are automatically proficient with sword-like weapons (including bastard swords, daggers, elven curve blades, falchions, greatswords, kukris, longswords, punching daggers, rapiers, scimitars, short swords, and two-bladed swords).

traits.name: Natural Weapons
traits.text: A tengu has a bite attack that deals 1d3 points of damage.

traits.name: Senses
traits.text: Tengus have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Tieflings have a base speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Resistance
traits.text: Tieflings have cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

traits.name: Skilled
traits.text: Tieflings gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Spell-like ability
traits.text: Tieflings can use darkness once per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level for this ability equals the tiefling’s class level.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Tieflings can see perfectly in the dark for up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Sorcery
traits.text: Tiefling sorcerers with the Abyssal or Infernal bloodlines treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer class abilities.

traits.name: Energy Resistance
traits.text: Undines have cold resistance 5.

traits.name: Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: Undines can use hydraulic push 1/day (caster level equals the undine’s level).

traits.name: Water Affinity
traits.text: undine sorcerers with the elemental (water) bloodline treat their Charisma score as 2 points higher for all sorcerer spells and class abilities. undine clerics with the Water domain cast their Water domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Undines can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Changeling
languages: Common, the primary language of their host society

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.text: Changelings have a +1 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Claws
traits.text: Changelings’ fingernails are hard and sharp, granting them two claw attacks (1d4 points of damage each).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Changelings see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Hulking Changeling (Annis Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on melee damage.

traits.name: Pyrophile (Ash Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +1 racial bonus on damage rolls when using spells with the fire descriptor. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels the changeling has beyond 1st. Source PCS:CtIE

traits.name: Green Widow (Green Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on Bluff checks against creatures that are sexually attracted to her.

traits.name: Sea Lungs (Sea Hag)
traits.text: The changeling may hold her breath for a number of rounds equal to three times her Constitution before she risks drowning.

traits.name: Gaze Blindness (Mute Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

traits.name: Heartstone Heritor (Night Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

traits.name: Ice Climber (Winter Hag)
traits.text: The changeling gains a +5 racial bonus on Climb checks on icy or slippery surfaces. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

traits.name: Inscrutable (Blood Hag)
traits.text: The Sense Motive check DC to gain a hunch about the changeling increases by 5. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

traits.name: Wind Breaker (Storm Hag)
traits.text: The changeling is treated as two size categories larger for the purpose of resolving wind effects. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

traits.name: Duergar Immunities
traits.text: Duergar are immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

traits.name: Stability
traits.text: Duergar receive a +4 racial bonus to their CMD against bull rush or trip attempts while on solid ground.

traits.name: Enlarge Person Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: A duergar can use enlarge person once per day, using its character level as its caster level and affecting itself only.

traits.name: Invisibility Spell-Like Ability (Sp)
traits.text: A duergar can use invisibility once per day, using its character level as its caster level and affecting itself only.

traits.name: Superior Darkvision
traits.text: Duergar have superior darkvision, allowing them to see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Light Sensitivity
traits.text: Duergar are dazzled in areas of bright light.

traits.name: Enchantment Resistance
traits.text: Gillmen gain a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a –2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Gillmen can breathe both water and air.

traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text: Gripplis receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Gripplis are proficient with nets.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Gripplis can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Kitsune Magic (Ex/Sp)
traits.text: Kitsune add +1 to the DC of any saving throws against enchantment spells that they cast. Kitsune with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like ability: 3/day—dancing lights (caster level equals the kitsune’s level).

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Kitsune can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Armor
traits.text: Merfolk have a +2 natural armor bonus.

traits.name: Legless
traits.text: Merfolk have no legs, and therefore cannot be tripped.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Merfolk have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Merfolk are amphibious, but prefer not to spend long periods out of the water.

traits.name: Lifebound (Ex)
traits.text: Samsarans gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws made to resist death effects, saving throws against negative energy effects, Fortitude saves made to remove negative levels, and Constitution checks made to stabilize if reduced to negative hit points.

traits.name: Shards of the Past (Ex)
traits.text: A samsaran’s past lives grant her bonuses on two particular skills. A samsaran chooses two skills—she gains a +2 racial bonus on both of these skills, and they are treated as class skills regardless of what class she actually takes.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Samsaran Magic (Sp)
traits.text: Samsarans with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—comprehend languages, deathwatch, and stabilize. The caster level for these effects is equal to the samsaran’s level.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.text: Strix gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Suspicious
traits.text: Strix receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells and effects.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Strix receive a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures with the human subtype because of their special training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Strix see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, Strix have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Suli
languages: Common, one elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran)

traits.name: Energy Resistance 5
traits.text: Sulis have resistance to acid 5, cold 5, electricity 5, and fire 5.

traits.name: Negotiator
traits.text: Sulis are keen negotiators, and gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Sulis can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Svirfneblin have a base speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Defensive Training
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class.

traits.name: Fortunate
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

traits.name: Spell Resistance
traits.text: Svirfneblin have spell resistance (SR) equal to 11 + their class levels.

traits.name: Skills
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.text: Svirfneblin gain stonecunning (as dwarves.)

traits.name: Svirfneblin Magic
traits.text: Svirfneblin add +1 to the DC of any illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: Constant—nondetection; 1/day—blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin’s class levels.

traits.name: Hatred
traits.text: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Svirfneblin can see perfectly in the dark up to 120 feet.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: In addition to their ability to see perfectly in the dark up to 60 ft, svirfneblin have low-light vision, allowing them to see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Speed
traits.text: Vanaras have a base speed of 30 feet and a climb speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.text: Vanaras have a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: A vanara can see twice as far as a human in dim light.

traits.name: Prehensile Tail
traits.text: A vanara has a long, flexible tail that she can use to carry objects. She cannot wield weapons with her tail, but the tail allows her to retrieve a small, stowed object carried on her person as a swift action.

traits.name: Poison Resistance
traits.text: A vishkanya has a racial bonus on saving throws against poison equal to its Hit Dice.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.text: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Limber
traits.text: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.text: Vishkanyas can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

traits.name: Poison Use
traits.text: Vishkanyas are skilled in the use of poison and never accidentally poison themselves when using or applying poison.

traits.name: Toxic
traits.text: A number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), a vishkanya can envenom a weapon that he wields with his toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires the vishkanya to be injured when he uses this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action. Vishkanya Venom: Injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 the vishkanya’s Hit Dice + the vishkanya’s Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Dex; cure 1 save.

traits.name: Weapon Familiarity
traits.text: Vishkanyas are always proficient with blowguns, kukri, and shuriken.

traits.name: Shadow Resistance
traits.text: Wayangs get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells of the shadow subschool.

traits.name: Lurker
traits.text: Wayangs gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

traits.name: Shadow Magic
traits.text: Wayangs add +1 to the DC of any saving throws against spells of the shadow subschool that they cast. Wayangs with a Charisma score of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—ghost sound, pass without trace, and ventriloquism. The caster level for these effects is equal to the wayang’s level. The DC for these spells is equal to 10 + the spell’s level + the wayang’s Charisma modifier.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.text: Wayangs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

traits.name: Light and Dark (Su)
traits.text: Once per day as an immediate action, a wayang can treat positive and negative energy effects as if she were an undead creature, taking damage from positive energy and healing damage from negative energy. This ability lasts for 1 minute once activated.
